title: cercidium torreyanum
intro: Cercidium torreyanum, commonly known as the Palo Santo tree, is a plant native to South America, specifically in the countries of Ecuador, Peru, and Bolivia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, including health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Palo Santo tree include its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, promote relaxation, and relieve symptoms of insomnia and pain. The bioactive constituents present in the tree include limonene, beta-pinene, and myrcene, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
